text: This report recommends that City Council approve an application under Section 33 of the Ontario Heritage Act to alter heritage attributes of a designated heritage property at 64 Wellesley Street East in connection with the proposed development of the subject property. The application for Site Plan Control is subject to a Heritage Permit application under the Ontario Heritage Act because a previously approved application related to an approved Zoning By-law Amendment has been revised. The subject property at 64 Wellesley Street East contains the Wellesley Apartments, a five-storey, multi-unit residential apartment building constructed in 1931. City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1.
